provenance: SIMULATED inspection outcomes keyed by claim ID. Kept in this separate file so queue ranking never sees them.

definitions.resolved: The visit established the sowing method for a case the desk evidence could not settle (score in the review band or unscored), and it matched the claim.
definitions.corrected: The visit found that the claimed sowing method was wrong, so the decision changed.
definitions.unresolved: The visit could not establish the method (field already harvested or prepared, no access, boundary mismatch) or only re-confirmed what the desk evidence already supported.

resolving_or_correcting: A visit counts toward the replay metric when its outcome is resolved or corrected.
generation_assumption: Latent true method drawn with P(DSR) = simulated score (0.5 when unscored); 15% of visits arrive after harvest and are unresolved regardless of score. Treating the score as a probability is an assumption, not demonstrated calibration, and it favours ambiguity-ordered policies by construction.
